title: Resort Credit Standing on the Covered Holding and Set Against a Payout
content:
Where the holding a Pass and Trip Protection plan is written over carries resort credit issued to it under the
Season Pass Programme, that credit is set against what the claim pays.

| The covered holding's Season Pass Programme account carries | Set against what the claim pays |
| --- | --- |
| Resort credit issued in the season for the pass being given up | The whole of the credit issued for the pass being given up |
| No credit for the pass being given up, and resort credit issued in the season in recovery of service | The whole of the credit issued in recovery of service |
| Neither | Nothing on this ground |

**Reading the schedule.** The rows are read in the order given. Credit issued because the pass was given up
takes precedence: where any such credit stands on the covered holding's account within the season, the whole
of it is set against the payout, and credit issued in recovery of service is not reached. Only where no credit
for the pass being given up stands at all does credit issued in recovery of service come into play, and then
the whole of that credit is set against the payout. The amounts are the totals the covered holding's account
carries for the season, not the amount of a single entry.

**Illustrations (hypothetical inputs).** A covered holding whose account carries 150.00 USD of credit issued
for the pass being given up and 60.00 USD issued in recovery of service: 150.00 USD is set against what the
claim pays and the 60.00 USD is not. The same holding carrying only the 60.00 USD issued in recovery of
service: 60.00 USD is set against. A holding carrying neither: nothing is set against the payout on this
ground.
